labelled_by: Labels were drafted by AI agents (clip-evaluator) from video frames, with human spot checks only where noted in a rep's notes. No rep has a human spot check unless it says so.

label_classes.FULL: arms near-straight at the bottom and chin reaches/passes the bar
label_classes.SHORT_BOTTOM: arms never straighten at the bottom
label_classes.NOT_HIGH: chin short of the bar at the top

split_rule: Split by clip, not by rep. New clips are sorted by ascending Pexels ID and alternate held_out, calibration, held_out, calibration. The rule uses no label or video content. NOTE: it was written after the labels were drafted (the labels were seen first), so it is mechanical but not blind. The two earlier user-labelled clips (pexels_10336041, pexels_6389831; labels in data/labels/, all reps FULL) are calibration by definition: they already set the 3D dead-hang threshold.
held_out_rule: Held-out clips never inform any threshold, offset, landmark choice or margin.

clips.notes: 9 rep tops. Clip starts mid-descent of an earlier rep (cut off, not counted). Reps 1-6 are continuous (no pause between reps); long dead hang 11.3-13.4 s before rep 7. Judged from contact sheets at 8 fps and full-res crops at 3 frames around each bottom and top; no tracking output used. Bottom straightness is judged from a front/oblique view so elbow angle is foreshortened; all bottoms look near-straight, rep 7 clearly straight. From rep 6 on the camera is frontal and the fists cover the chin at the top, so top labels there are low confidence.

clips.notes: A rep IS performed: two assisted reps (spotter supports legs/hips, so some assistance is likely) with straight-arm bottoms and head above the bar line at the top, followed by a long bent-arm top hold with leg swinging and a slow lowering to a straight-arm hang by ~9.2 s. Chin cannot be seen (back view); judged from head/neck position relative to the bar line, so tops are medium confidence at best. Other people: spotter (front/right, supports legs until ~3.3 s then stands beside/beyond the rig), a distant person in the background on a treadmill area, and a hand/arm and chair edge from the spotter near the right edge from ~6 s. No frames were extracted from detector output or keypoint caches; labels are from visual inspection only. Scratch images: data/labels/draft/pexels_10039581/*.jpg.

clips.notes: Eight kipping cycles of roughly 2.1 s each, same pattern every time: hang with arms near-straight and legs below, then a leg swing forward while pulling, chin at the bar with body diagonal, then drop. First rep starts at clip start, last rep is cut off by the end of the clip. A few passers-by/cyclists in the far background only.
